observations: Standing cooker with a black finish.
Top surface has three gas burners and one electric solid hotplate.
Five control knobs are visible on the front panel.
Oven door features a brown/wood-effect handle.
The unit is partially wrapped in protective plastic film at the base.
A watermark 'HITECH TECHNOLOGIES' is present on the image.
The photo is taken outdoors on a paved surface next to a vehicle.
No brand name or model number is legible on the appliance.

claims.evidence: The exterior looks freshly finished, but internal refurbishment cannot be confirmed from a single photo.
No photos show the burners lit, the electric plate heating, or the oven in operation.

risks.risk: Gas burners or valves may be blocked or leaking.
risks.proof: A video showing all three gas burners ignited and staying lit.

risks.risk: The electric hotplate may be burnt out or have a short circuit.
risks.proof: A video showing the electric plate heating up (e.g., boiling a small amount of water).

risks.risk: The oven burner or thermostat may be faulty.
risks.proof: A photo of the oven interior with the burner lit.

risks.risk: Refurbishment may hide significant rust or structural damage under fresh paint.
risks.proof: Photos of the back panel and the interior floor of the oven.

proof_requests: Video of all three gas burners and the electric hotplate working simultaneously.
Photo of the oven interior with the burner lit.
Clear photo of the manufacturer's identification plate showing brand and model.
Photos of the back and sides of the cooker without the plastic wrapping.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified by type as a 3+1 standing cooker. While the 'perfect working condition' is unproven, it can be priced at the low end of the standing cooker market as a non-functional or unverified unit.
